sv.title: Försäljningen ökar under novemberrean
sv.summary: Konsumtionen under årets Black Friday-rea ökar. Men under själva fredagen krymper försäljningen, enligt nya siffror.

en.title: Sales Rise During November Sale
en.summary: Consumption during this year's Black Friday sale is rising. But on Friday itself, sales are shrinking, according to new figures.
